subject: Request: Trial extension and sandbox credits due to connector code freeze
messages:
From: Ayla Park <ayla@integrify.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: integrify-devs@integrify.com, Carlos Mendez <carlos@integrify.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: Connector failing during QA — request for trial runway extension

Hi Olga,

We hit a block this morning on the Integrify -> Redwood connector during end-to-end QA. Our engineers are seeing a stateful session failure when the KV cache grows past ~1.2M tokens; it causes a cascade of retries and stalls the pipeline. We're in a temporary code freeze while we triage—this will push our demo and the wider POC out by at least 3 weeks.

Given the delay, can you help with two things:
- A short sandbox token top-up (we're ~85% through current credits and tests will spike once we resume), and
- A one-month trial extension so we can finish integration and get a production-ready result before commit.

I've attached the small error log and a brief excerpt from our QA run that shows the failure pattern (error_log_20270620.txt). If you need an architecture walk-through, Carlos and I are available this afternoon.

We really like Redwood's latency profile but this integration hiccup is the gating item for our execs — an extra runway would make a big difference for the decision timeline.

Thanks,
Ayla
Ayla Park
Head of Integrations, Integrify
ayla@integrify.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: error_log_20270620.txt (text)
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Ayla Park <ayla@integrify.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Connector failing during QA — request for trial runway extension

Hi Ayla,

Thanks for the log — that helps. Sorry to hear you hit a code-freeze right before the demo window. Quick notes:
- We're seeing the same pattern in the logs you sent; looks like an edge case with very long-lived KV entries combined with our prefix cache eviction.
- David (cc'd) can pair with your eng team for a focused 60–90 minute triage today. He'll look at cache trimming and a temporary config that should avoid the retry cascade.

On the commercial side: I'm going to escalate a trial-extension/top-up request to our sales ops team. For immediate breathing room, I can provision a one-time sandbox top-up (small token package) pending formal approval. Can you confirm the amount of additional tokens you'd like to request? Also confirm preferred demo window dates once you have an estimate on the unblock timeline.

I'll coordinate internally and circle back within the hour with next steps.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0210
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: FWD: Urgent: Connector failing during QA — request for trial runway extension

Laura / Ben — quick context and ask below.

Integrify (potential mid-market fintech) is blocked on a connector failure during their QA run; they're in a short-term code freeze and estimate a 2–4 week slip to the POC completion. They've asked for:
1) A small immediate sandbox top-up to finish automation tests (they're ~85% through current credits), and
2) A one-month extension to their trial window to preserve the demo and evaluation cadence.

Technical impact: David is pairing with their devs today and expects a config workaround that reduces the likelihood of further retries. If the workaround holds, they'll need the tokens to validate across full test runs before the demo.

My recommended commercial response (minimal set to keep momentum):
- Provision a 50k-token sandbox top-up today (one-off, non-recurring) to avoid an interrupted test suite, and
- Grant a 30-day trial extension on the existing POC.

Rationale: Integrify is showing strong fit (latency-sensitive use case, clear go/no-go timelines). We risk losing buy if the demo window slides without runway. This is a low-cost, high-leverage gesture.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v3.docx (their updated timeline)

Can you sign off? If approved I'll send a formal offer and a short outline of acceptance terms (we usually require no new contract for a single-topup/extension).

Thanks,
Olga
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FWD: Urgent: Connector failing during QA — request for trial runway extension

Olga / Ben — approved.

Please proceed with the following limited make-good:
- Provision 50,000 tokens to Integrify's sandbox immediately (mark as one-time top-up, internal code: IF-TOPUP-50k).
- Extend the trial window by 30 calendar days from their current expiration date.
- Add a one-paragraph addendum to the mutual action plan noting "extension granted for integration testing, subject to observed progress; Redwood reserves right to reassess if progress stalls beyond 60 days."

Ben — please update HubSpot with the top-up and attach the mutual_action_plan_v3.docx and the docusign link below. Olga — once tokens are provisioned, reply to Ayla with confirmation + the DocuSign link for the addendum.

Approved by: Laura Bennett, Head of Sales Ops

Attachment: sandbox_topup_approval.pdf (pdf)
Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/IF-2027-311, https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCD-Integrify-Topup
